label: Forwarder deposit contract deployed on Robinhood testnet (issue #148). Testnet only. One transaction, owner-approved. No deposit and no payout was made.
rpc: Official https://rpc.testnet.chain.robinhood.com, reached through a local 127.0.0.1 relay that resolves the real host through Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS (the ISP's DNS returns a block page for the domain) and connects with the correct TLS server name. The earlier dRPC reads matched the official reads exactly.
mechanism: forge script evm/script/DeployForwarder.s.sol:DeployForwarder, key read from the environment inside the process (never a command-line argument), checked in-process against DEPLOYER_ADDRESS, exactly one broadcast transaction, simulated first.

retired.reason: Deposit-only: keeps tokens and has no withdrawal. Still holds the 100 mCASHCAT of the one test deposit (never attested to the registry). Must never be verified or attested.

notClaimed: No deposit through the forwarder and no payout from the holder has happened: the live proof that closes #148 is still open.
The payout contract's registered sender per backing is still unconfirmed (no view exists).
dRPC and the official RPC may share an upstream; the official RPC was reached through a local relay, not directly.
